topPRs.title: feat: consolidate Eliza Cloud into eliza.app
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #18806

## Outcome

- makes `eliza.app` the canonical homepage, login, and account origin
- makes `cloud.eliza.app` the hosted Eliza app and Cloud management origin
- embeds Cloud billing, management, observability, analytics, apps, MCPs, and admin routes inside the normal Eliza app shell
- exposes managed Cloud surfaces only for Cloud-managed agents while keeping local and VPS agents free of Cloud-only navigation
- removes the standalone dashboard shell and preserves `/dashboard/*` only as compatibility redirects to `/cloud/*`
- consolidates the homepage source into the single `packages/app` frontend build and removes the standalone homepage deployment lifecycle
- redirects legacy `elizacloud.ai` hosts, including the retired docs host, into canonical `eliza.app` routes
- consolidates auth, SSO, OAuth return targets, cookie/origin policy, API routing, and cloud-pair recovery around the canonical domains
- adds protected Cloudflare, Headscale, Railway tunnel-proxy, DNS import, certificate, and staged cutover workflows

## Verification

- `bun install` on the rebased revision
- `bun run verify`: 350/350 tasks and all repository audits passed; 8,000 test files scanned with no focused or orphaned skips
- `bun run --cwd packages/app build:web`
- real app Playwright Cloud route smoke: 3/3
- focused Cloud/UI/auth/routing/infra/workflow suites, including Cloud onboarding 80/80 and affected UI 27/27
- homepage source typecheck/lint/test/snapshot inventory
- `packages/ui`, `packages/app`, `packages/app-core`, Cloud API/shared/routing/SDK typechecks
- Terraform 1.10.5 fmt/init/validate and static contracts
- `actionlint` on deployment workflows
- Cloud Worker production dry-run

## Rollout note

Staging deployment is intentionally gated after merge. The `eliza.app` Cloudflare zone is currently on the Free plan, whose Universal SSL certificate does not cover nested per-agent hosts such as `*.cloud-staging.eliza.app` or `*.cloud.eliza.app`. The Terraform and workflows model the required Advanced Certificate Manager packs, but the zone entitlement must be purchased/approved before those wildcard certificates can converge. No purchase was made by this change.
